nouns.name: VerificationReport
nouns.notes: The row's compounding record: signed, dated, replayable. Owned by construction — every verification run produces first-party exhaust.

nouns.name: Monitor
nouns.notes: Continuous re-verification registrations; the continuously-verified half of worthiness-bar item (c).

nouns.name: TestSuite
nouns.notes: Publish/verify split is doctrinal: apis.ax publishes suites, api.qa independently verifies (#3 rule 5).

nouns.name: MockSpec
nouns.notes: Deterministic schema-conformant mock exhaust, content-addressed by digest.

face.$comment: The quartet is hand-authored in src/self.ts + src/worker.ts, NOT emitted via axp-faces: api.qa is the independent verifier — sharing generator code with the surfaces it judges would let a generator bug self-certify. Founder ruling pending on whether this independence exemption stands (see checklist row 3).

sandbox.$comment: §5.2 universal floor: GET /reports answers keyless with labeled synthetic seed records (reserved .example targets, mechanically shaped like real report exhaust); the REAL rail is one hop away (GET /{domain}, /self run the live verifier keylessly). Seed spec versioned with the code (src/self.ts SEED_REPORTS); reseed = build step.
sandbox.fixtureLaw: reserved .example targets only; no real company or person names; every record labeled example:true

suite.$comment: The runnable public suite is the npm package (npx autonomous-qa <domain>) + test/self.test.ts + test/self-pinned.test.ts (the pinned 2.6.0 admission gate run on itself). A digest-pinned interfaces.testSuite document is deliberately not declared until one exists that covers every declared operation and MCP tool (A.8.7 capability coverage) — presence-when-true.
